import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from h2 import *
T=[]
def add(name, jobs, want, wire=None):
    T.append((name, jobs, want, wire))
W_OK = ('MESSAGE sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1\r\nTo: <sip:b@y.test>\r\n'
        'Call-ID: c1\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nPrivacy: none\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: <sip:a@x.test>\r\n'
        'Content-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi')

# hop 1 local accepted -> hop 2 peer
j0 = job(req(), gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', trusted=True)
j1 = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=True, source=0)
want1 = {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'peer','private':False,'wire':W_OK}
add('hop2 of accept', [j0,j1], want1)
# hop2 with trusted_out False -> PAI omitted
j1b = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=False, source=0)
want1b = {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'peer','private':False,
  'wire':'MESSAGE sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1\r\nTo: <sip:b@y.test>\r\nCall-ID: c1\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nPrivacy: none\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi'}
add('hop2 trusted_out false', [j0,j1b], want1b)
# hop 3 reusing hop 2 wire
j2 = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=True, source=1)
add('hop3 same', [j0,j1,j2], want1)
# peer privacy hop: local privacy id trusted out true -> PAI emitted -> peer accepts
j0p = job(req({'Privacy':'id'}), gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', trusted=True)
j1p = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=True, source=0)
wantp = {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':'peer','private':True,
 'wire':'MESSAGE sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t1\r\nTo: <sip:b@y.test>\r\nCall-ID: c1\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nPrivacy: id\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi'}
add('peer privacy hop', [j0p,j1p], wantp)
# peer privacy hop trusted_out false
j1pq = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=False, source=0)
add('peer privacy hop untrusted out', [j0p,j1pq], wantp)
# source of a rejected job -> upstream
j0r = job(req({'From':'<sip:zz@x.test>;tag=t1'}), gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1')
j1r = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=0)
add('upstream', [j0r,j1r], rj('upstream'))
add('upstream chain', [j0r,j1r,job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=1)], rj('upstream'))
# source of an upstream -> upstream
# forward/self reference
add('self source', [j0, job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=1)], rj('upstream'))
add('future source', [job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=1), j0], rj('upstream'))
add('bad source index', [job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=5), j0], rj('upstream'))
add('negative source', [job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', source=-1)], rj('upstream'))
# hop where peer authority fails
j1f = job(None, gateway='far', kind='peer', peer='ghost', trusted=True, source=0)
add('hop unknown peer', [j0,j1f], rj('unauthenticated'))
# source into local ingress (no inherited auth)
j1l = job(None, gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', trusted=True, source=0)
add('hop to local', [j0,j1l], acc('sip:a@x.test'))
# hop2 where the wire grew past the limit
long_body = 'x'*32000
big = req(body=long_body)
j0b = job(big, gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1', trusted=True)
add('big accepted', [j0b], None)
j1b2 = job(None, gateway='any', kind='peer', peer='edge', trusted=True, source=0)
add('big hop', [j0b,j1b2], None)
# exactly 32768 raw is fine, wire is longer -> next hop syntax
add('raw 32768', [job(req(body='x'*(32768-309)))], None)
# untrusted ingress at hop
j1u = job(None, gateway='any', kind='untrusted', source=0)
add('hop untrusted', [j0,j1u], rj('unauthenticated'))

for name, jobs, want, wire in T:
    got = run(batch(jobs))['results'][-1]
    if want is not None:
        check(name, got, want, wire)
    else:
        print('%-30s -> %s' % (name, json.dumps(got)[:150]))
